course.title: Unit 1 Animal Friends【例句】
course.description: Section B How are animals part of our lives?

sentences.content: What do you know about elephants?
sentences.english: What do you know about elephants ?
sentences.chinese: 你对大象了解多少？

sentences.content: The elephant is my favourite animal.
sentences.english: The elephant is my favourite animal
sentences.chinese: 大象是我最喜欢的动物。

sentences.content: I love elephants because they are strong and clever.
sentences.english: I love elephants because they are strong and clever
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢大象，因为它们既强壮又聪明。

sentences.content: They are also a symbol of good luck here.
sentences.english: They are also a symbol of good luck here
sentences.chinese: 它们在这里也是好运的象征。

sentences.content: The elephant is our national animal.
sentences.english: The elephant is our national animal
sentences.chinese: 大象是我们的国宝动物。

sentences.content: On 13 March, we celebrate Thai Elephant Day.
sentences.english: On 13 March , we celebrate Thai Elephant Day
sentences.chinese: 3月13日，我们庆祝泰国大象日。

sentences.content: Elephants look very different from other animals.
sentences.english: Elephants look very different from other animals
sentences.chinese: 大象看起来与其他动物截然不同。

sentences.content: They are huge.
sentences.english: They are huge
sentences.chinese: 它们非常庞大。

sentences.content: They have large ears and long trunks.
sentences.english: They have large ears and long trunks
sentences.chinese: 它们长着大耳朵和长鼻子。

sentences.content: They can pick up and carry heavy things with their trunks.
sentences.english: They can pick up and carry heavy things with their trunks
sentences.chinese: 它们可以用象鼻拾起并搬运重物。

sentences.content: Elephants are like us in some ways.
sentences.english: Elephants are like us in some ways
sentences.chinese: 大象在某些方面与我们相似。

sentences.content: They are very playful and love to play in the water.
sentences.english: They are very playful and love to play in the water
sentences.chinese: 它们非常活泼好动，喜欢在水中嬉戏。

sentences.content: They are great swimmers.
sentences.english: They are great swimmers
sentences.chinese: 他们是游泳健将。

wordDetails.definition: are（现在时）: 构成现在进行时

sentences.content: They are also clever.
sentences.english: They are also clever
sentences.chinese: 他们也很聪明。

sentences.content: For example, they can remember one another and places with food and water after many years.
sentences.english: For example , they can remember one another and places with food and water after many years
sentences.chinese: 例如，它们能够记住彼此以及有食物和水的地点，即使多年过去仍不会遗忘。

sentences.content: Elephants are very kind too.
sentences.english: Elephants are very kind too
sentences.chinese: 大象也非常友善。

sentences.content: They look after other elephants when they don’t feel well.
sentences.english: They look after other elephants when they don't feel well
sentences.chinese: 它们在其他大象身体不适时会照顾它们。

sentences.content: The big elephants also help the baby ones.
sentences.english: The big elephants also help the baby ones
sentences.chinese: 大象们也会帮助小象。

sentences.content: Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture.
sentences.english: Elephants are an important part of Thai life and culture
sentences.chinese: 大象是泰国生活与文化的重要组成部分。

sentences.content: However, they are in danger.
sentences.english: However , they are in danger
sentences.chinese: 然而，他们正处于危险之中。

sentences.content: They live in forests, but people cut down too many trees.
sentences.english: They live in forests , but people cut down too many trees
sentences.chinese: 它们栖息在森林中，但人们砍伐了太多树木。

sentences.content: People also kill elephants for their ivory.
sentences.english: People also kill elephants for their ivory
sentences.chinese: 人们也会为了获取象牙而猎杀大象。

sentences.content: Let’s save the forests and not buy things made of ivory.
sentences.english: Let's save the forests and not buy things made of ivory
sentences.chinese: 让我们拯救森林，拒绝购买象牙制品。

sentences.content: Every elephant counts.
sentences.english: Every elephant counts
sentences.chinese: 每一头大象都至关重要。

wordDetails.definition: count（第三人称单数）: 重要

sentences.content: My dog, Xiaohua, is part of the family.
sentences.english: My dog , Xiaohua , is part of the family
sentences.chinese: 我的狗狗Xiaohua是家里的一员。

sentences.content: She is quite a big dog, but she is not scary at all!
sentences.english: She is quite a big dog , but she is not scary at all !
sentences.chinese: 它虽然是只大狗，但一点也不吓人！

sentences.content: She has beautiful fur and loves to play with everyone.
sentences.english: She has beautiful fur and loves to play with everyone
sentences.chinese: 她有一身漂亮的皮毛，喜欢和大家一起玩耍。

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有
love（第三人称单数现在时）: 爱

sentences.content: She is really friendly.
sentences.english: She is really friendly
sentences.chinese: 她非常友善。

sentences.content: You see, I am blind.
sentences.english: You see , I am blind
sentences.chinese: 你看，我是个盲人。

sentences.content: Xiaohua is my eyes.
sentences.english: Xiaohua is my eyes
sentences.chinese: Xiaohua是我的眼睛。

sentences.content: She helps me find my way around.
sentences.english: She helps me find my way around
sentences.chinese: 她帮我熟悉周围的环境。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数现在时）: 帮助

sentences.content: She can see and has great hearing.
sentences.english: She can see and has great hearing
sentences.chinese: 她视力良好，听觉敏锐。

sentences.content: She helps me walk to school and stay safe.
sentences.english: She helps me walk to school and stay safe
sentences.chinese: 她帮助我步行上学并确保安全。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数现在时）: 帮助

sentences.content: I love her very much.
sentences.english: I love her very much
sentences.chinese: 我非常爱她。

sentences.content: We are close friends.
sentences.english: We are close friends
sentences.chinese: 我们是亲密的朋友。
